title: 玻璃盒内的图像可视化
prompt: photorealistic image of a [COLOR] 3D [SUBJECT] encased in a luxurious transparent box, viewed from an enhanced side angle to better reveal the 3D shape of the [SUBJECT]. The box should be white, exquisitely designed, featuring crystal-clear glass with refined, sharp edges
description: 使用 Nano Banana Pro 模型，轻松打造逼真的三维物体视觉展示，适用于高端产品摄影和电商陈列，通过透明玻璃盒突显立体形态与奢华质感。
